description: Computes a real-estate broker’s commission on a deal: the commission, the tax on the commission (VAT is on the commission, not the property), the split with a co-broker office and the agent’s share. Works with any currency.

share.description: This office’s share of the commission % (100 if no co-broker)

vat.description: Tax % on the commission (e.g. 15 in Saudi Arabia), 0 if none

name: commission_calculator
title: Real-estate commission calculator
